messages:
priya_support: Escalating Solaris Labs — recurring 429s on embeddings causing search failures for multiple users. Customer flagged renewal concerns during today's check-in.
omar_cs: thanks. are these rate limits from our side or theirs?
lucy_eng: we're seeing 429s with quota-exceeded header on the tenant: solaris-74. Sample:\n```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nRetry-After: 30\n{\"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"limit\":1000}\n```
priya_support: Solaris says they didn't change traffic patterns; started at 13:00 UTC. Contact: j.chen@solaris.ai. They have a big demo tomorrow.
omar_cs: mark P0 for CS — impacts go-live and renewal. Need an immediate comms note and short-term remediation. Pause renewal automation until cleared.
maria_sales: pausing renewal emails now. If this is our quota issue, approve offering a one-month pro-rated credit if unresolved in 4h.
lucy_eng: probable cause: quota bucket misattributed after a recent growth-plan change. Short-term fix: increase tenant quota and reset usage counters. I can run the command — ETA 20m.
priya_support: infra-bot: request quota increase for tenant solaris-74 to 5000 tokens/min
infra-bot: request received; ticket INF-5120 created and assigned to lucy_eng
lucy_eng: applied quota bump and reset counters. Monitoring for spikes.
priya_support: running validation tests — embedding writes now succeed and no 429s in 10m window. Solaris confirmed search restored.
omar_cs: drafting external message: "We're aware of degraded search for Solaris earlier today caused by a quota misconfiguration. We've applied a fix and are monitoring. We'll follow up with details and a credit if needed." Approving send.
maria_sales: billing note queued; finance will calculate pro-rated credit if required. Owners: ENG=lucy_eng, SUPPORT=priya_support, CS=omar_cs, SALES=maria_sales.
infra-bot: INF-5120 updated: quota change executed, verification complete, awaiting billing note for closure.
priya_support: closing thread, will reopen if Solaris reports regression. :white_check_mark:
